faq.q: Can I pay to be recommended by ChatGPT?
faq.a: No. There's no advertising product, listing fee or submission form that places a business in ChatGPT's recommendations. You get named by being easy to find and widely trusted online.

faq.q: Does ChatGPT use Google to find businesses?
faq.a: Not mainly. ChatGPT's live search uses OpenAI's own crawler and Bing's index, so verify your site in Bing Webmaster Tools and claim Bing Places as well as Google Business Profile.

faq.q: How long does it take to get recommended by ChatGPT?
faq.a: Technical fixes can reach Bing within days, but reviews and third-party mentions build up over weeks. Most small businesses should allow 6 to 12 weeks before judging results.

faq.q: Does this work for local businesses in the UK?
faq.a: Yes. Local prompts like "best plumber in Leeds" lean heavily on directories, reviews and pages that name a service and a town, all things a small local business can control.

faq.q: How do I check if ChatGPT recommends my business?
faq.a: Ask it the questions your customers would ask, in a fresh logged-out chat, and record who it names each month. Check GA4 for visits from chatgpt.com too.

faq.q: Do I need an agency to get recommended by ChatGPT?
faq.a: No. Every step in this guide can be done yourself. A monthly plan saves time and adds tracking across several AI engines; it shouldn't cost thousands.
